title: Enforce active Agent scope at public M8 Skill entry points
goal: Ensure every public M8 Skill execution entry point enforces the active default Agent manifest and workspace setting before allowing a discovered Skill to execute.
context: Issue #347 requires Agent scope to be enforced at the execution boundary. M8CompositionRoot.runChatSkillIfMatched passes a scoped Agent to SkillAgentOrchestrator, but public executeSkill calls SkillRuntime directly and runSkillAgent invokes the unscoped orchestrator overload.
forbidden_changes: Do not broaden the default Agent Skill list or auto-authorize imported Skills.
Do not bypass ModuleRuntime policy, approval, schema, cancellation, or verification.
Do not modify UI, provider/GGUF, or unrelated runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: M8 executeSkill rejects a discoverable Skill that is not declared by the active default Agent.
M8 runSkillAgent selects and executes only Skills declared by the active default Agent.
Workspace Skills remain excluded when workspaceToolsEnabled is false.
Regression tests prove an explicitly registered but out-of-scope Skill cannot execute through either public API.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA checks on the final PR head.
recovery: If scope tests expose compatibility issues, preserve fail-closed Agent scope and make the smallest change within M8 composition; do not weaken the regression to permit unscoped execution.
